name: labs/ad-sdl__ur_module
title: Universal Robots arm (ur_interface.ur:UR)
intro: Universal Robots arm (ur_interface.ur:UR), adapted from ad-sdl/ur_module. It reads `movement_state`, `joint_positions`, `robot_mode`, `safety_status` and 5 more; runs `home`, `pause_program`, `stop_program`, `power_off_arm` and 1 more. `home`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ad-sdl__ur_module --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ad-sdl__ur_module --backend fake --mcp
